blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Just like any other ordinary tourist, Vice President Sara Duterte appears to be an avid fan of Japan’s discount store Don Quijote, as an analyst called by the prosecution panel claimed that she spent more than P200,000 for two stores on two different occasions using her credit card. At the tail end of Duterte’s impeachment trial at the Senate on Friday, public prosecutor and Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno questioned their witness, financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera, about Table 25 of his report, which listed the transactions made by Duterte using her credit card. Cabrera then said […]...
